name: Daily catalog sync

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 10 * * *'
      timezone: 'America/New_York'

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: daily-catalog-sync
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Sync Apify and CoreClaw catalogs
        run: node settings/sync_catalog.js
      - name: Commit catalog changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add catalog/README.md featured/coreclaw.md
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No catalog changes detected."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "chore: sync data API catalogs"
          git push

# 🏠 Real Estate Data APIs **Property listings, valuations, rental intelligence, agent research, and market data APIs.** [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/cporter202/real-estate-data-apis?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/cporter202/real-estate-data-apis/stargazers) [![Daily sync](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/cporter202/real-estate-data-apis/daily-sync.yml?label=daily%20sync&style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/cporter202/real-estate-data-apis/actions/workflows/daily-sync.yml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/cporter202/real-estate-data-apis?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE)

## What this repo is A focused directory of APIs and web-data workers for building real-estate software, investment research tools, rental dashboards, property alerts, and market-intelligence workflows. The API lists are the main content of this repository: - [Browse Apify real-estate APIs](catalog/README.md) — a large directory of ready-to-use actors. - [Browse CoreClaw real-estate APIs](catalog/coreclaw.md) — worker APIs with API and MCP access. | API list | What you will find | |---|---| | [Apify API list](catalog/README.md) | The full real-estate API directory, with one entry per actor and description. | | [CoreClaw API list](catalog/coreclaw.md) | The full real-estate API directory, with worker IDs and capabilities. | | Coverage snapshot | Current directory | |---|---:| | Apify real-estate actors | **1,089** | | CoreClaw real-estate workers | **1** | | Sync cadence | **Daily** | ## Start with a job to be done | If you need to… | Start here | |---|---| | Search listings or collect property details | [Apify catalog](catalog/README.md) | | Find Zillow property data quickly | [CoreClaw API list](catalog/coreclaw.md) | | Build a rental or sales monitoring dashboard | [Rental monitoring playbook](playbooks/rental-monitoring.md) | | Research investor or FSBO opportunities | [Investor research playbook](playbooks/investor-research.md) | | Compare providers before building | [Provider selection checklist](playbooks/provider-selection.md) | ## Common build paths - Property-search and listing aggregation - Rental-price and availability monitoring - FSBO, investor, and agent lead research - Comparable-property and valuation dashboards - Neighborhood, map, and location intelligence - Market reports and recurring data products ## Audience Real-estate apps, agents and brokers, investors, market researchers, and PropTech builders. ## Provider notes This repository preserves referral parameters present in the API lists where available. See [LINKS.md](LINKS.md) for a neutral referral-link note. A referral link is not an endorsement of fit, quality, legality, or pricing. Use public data responsibly. Review provider documentation, platform terms, privacy obligations, rate limits, and applicable real-estate regulations before launching a production workflow. ## Maintenance GitHub Actions checks the upstream Apify and CoreClaw category directories daily and updates only the catalog files when their content changes. The sync can also be run locally: ```bash node settings/sync_catalog.js ``` The source URLs and update behavior are documented in [settings/repo.config.json](settings/repo.config.json). ## Related directories - [API Mega List](https://github.com/cporter202/API-mega-list) - [Ecommerce Intelligence APIs](https://github.com/cporter202/ecommerce-intelligence-apis) - [Job Data APIs and Scrapers](https://github.com/cporter202/job-data-apis-and-scrapers)

# Integration examples

This directory is reserved for small, provider-neutral examples. Keep credentials out of git and use environment variables for API tokens.

The safest first test is a small, permitted request against one source URL. Record the request timestamp, source URL, response schema, and any fields that were unavailable.

# Investor and FSBO research workflow

Combine property-detail extraction with public listing search, location data, and a review step. Keep a source URL and capture timestamp for every record so the output can be audited later.

Recommended fields:

- Address and coordinates
- Asking price and estimated market value
- Property type, beds, baths, and square footage
- Listing status and days on market
- Agent or seller contact fields when publicly provided
- Source URL, retrieval time, and confidence notes

Do not treat an automated estimate as an appraisal or investment advice.

# Rental monitoring workflow

1. Collect listing URLs or search results from the [Apify catalog](../catalog/README.md).
2. Normalize address, price, beds, baths, square footage, availability, and listing timestamps.
3. Store a first-seen and last-seen record so price and availability changes are measurable.
4. Add a location or geocoding step only after the source data is clean.
5. Send threshold alerts to a dashboard, email, or webhook.

Useful outputs include rent changes, new listings, removed listings, time on market, and neighborhood-level supply snapshots.
